summary.headline: Day 15 post-redesign (rolling 8-day window Jun 8-15): GSC clicks 174 (+26 vs prior 7-day snapshot), impressions 19,212, avg position 22.77 (+0.09 WoW). GA4 sessions 521 (+69 WoW, engagement 48.8%). Tracked keywords: 18 top-3, 36 top-10, 66 ranked in top-100 (US: 32/70 in top-10; Phoenix: 4/32 in top-10). 17 local pack entries detected across 32 Phoenix SERPs — major shift from 0 last week.
content_strategy: Double down on the Phoenix local pack momentum — 17 local pack entries detected this week vs 0 last week. Audit GBP listing for completeness, add weekly posts/photos, and request reviews from recent installs.

Calculator page is the #1 traffic driver (60 clicks, 2,683 impressions). Add internal links from every product page and the home page to /artificial-turf-calculator/ with the anchor 'turf cost calculator'.

/diy-guide-to-installing-artificial-turf-in-your-backyard/ is sitting at avg position 14.8 with 563 impressions and 0 clicks. CTR is the issue, not ranking. Rewrite title + meta to match 'how to install artificial turf' intent and add a hero image with alt text.
Service-areas/utah/provo (avg pos 14.7, 1,669 impressions, 12 clicks) is your highest-impression non-PHX local page. Mirror this template for 2-3 other Utah cities to capture nearby SERPs.
Add FAQ schema blocks to product pages (Lush 80, Lucky 77, Lush 70) — they're sitting at positions 10-12 and FAQ schema unlocks rich results that boost CTR by 15-25%.
next_steps: Shorten home title from 66 to 60 chars to prevent SERP truncation (only structural audit finding; affects the highest-impression page on the site at 6,236 weekly impressions).
Provision a dedicated PageSpeed Insights API key (free tier ~25k/day at https://developers.google.com/speed/docs/insights/v5/get-started). Shared-IP quota has 429'd PSI for the 4th consecutive week.
Reactivate the DataForSEO Backlinks add-on at app.dataforseo.com/backlinks-subscription. Backlinks have been frozen at 416 / 172 RD for 2 weeks — can't see if the redesign is winning new links.
